eh|jo: Western Sahara and Jordan both have black, white and green stripes with a red triangle at the hoist. Jordan has a small white star in the triangle; Western Sahara has a red crescent and star on the white stripe.
eh|ps: Western Sahara and Palestine both have black, white and green stripes with a red triangle at the hoist. Western Sahara adds a red crescent and star on the white stripe; Palestine's stripes are plain.
ir|somaliland: Iran and Somaliland are both green, white and red horizontal stripes with Arabic writing. Iran has a red emblem in the centre and script along the stripe edges; Somaliland has white script on the green and a black star in the centre.
northern-cyprus|tn: Northern Cyprus and Tunisia both show a red crescent and star on white. Tunisia's sit in a white disc on a red field; Northern Cyprus is white all over with two thin red stripes.
northern-cyprus|tr: Northern Cyprus and Turkey both show a crescent and star. Turkey is a white crescent and star on red; Northern Cyprus reverses it to red on white and adds two thin red stripes.
